qe: The scientific study of birds is called:
qh: पक्षियों के वैज्ञानिक अध्ययन को कहते हैं:
e: Concept: Har jeev-samuh ke adhyayan ka alag naam hota hai. Ornithology = pakshiyon (birds) ka adhyayan - unka dhaancha, udaan, pravasi (migration), ghonsla aur behaviour. Baaki teen alag shastr hain: Herpetology (sarisrip + ubhaychar - snake, lizard, frog), Entomology (keet/insects), Ichthyology (machhliyan). Pravasi pakshi (migratory birds) har saal hazaaron kilometre udte hain - jaise Siberian crane Bharat aata hai; unke udaan ke raste ko 'flyway' kehte hain. Ornithology me pakshiyon ki chonch, pankh, ghonsla aur unke andon ka adhyayan bhi hota hai. Exam point: 'Birds = Ornithology; Insects = Entomology; Fish = Ichthyology'.

qe: The branch of biology that deals with the study of reptiles and amphibians is:
qh: सरीसृपों और उभयचरों के अध्ययन की शाखा कहलाती है:
e: Concept: Herpetology me do group ek saath padhe jate hain - reptiles (sarisrip: chhipkali, saanp, kachhua) aur amphibians (ubhaychar: mendhak, toad, salamander), kyunki purane vaigyanikon ne inhe ek hi group maana tha aur aaj bhi inka adhyayan saath hota hai. Baaki teen alag shastr hain: Ornithology (pakshi), Entomology (keet), Serpentology (sirf saanp - koi standard branch nahi). Exam point: 'Reptiles + Amphibians = Herpetology'.

qe: The scientific study of insects is known as:
qh: कीटों के वैज्ञानिक अध्ययन को कहा जाता है:
e: Concept: Entomology = keeton (insects) ka adhyayan; ye krishi (agriculture) ke liye bahut zaroori hai kyunki kai keede fasal ka nuksaan karte hain (pest) aur kai labhkari hote hain (madhummakhi, resham ki keedia, lac insect). Forensic science me bhi keet se maut ke samay ka andaza lagaya jata hai. Baaki teen: Ornithology (pakshi), Herpetology (sarisrip+ubhaychar), Ethnology (manav sanskriti/jaatiyon ka adhyayan - biology nahi). Exam point: 'Insects = Entomology (keet-vigyan)'.

qe: The study of algae is called:
qh: शैवालों (algae) के अध्ययन को कहते हैं:
e: Concept: Phycology (ya Algology) = shaiwal (algae) ka adhyayan. Algae wo saral paudhe hain jisme chlorophyll hota hai par asli jad/tana/patte nahi hote; samudra me paani ki saaf-safai aur duniya ki badi hissa oxygen inhi se banta hai. Baaki teen alag shastr hain: Mycology (fungi/kavak), Virology (virus), Bacteriology (bacteria). Algae samudra ke 'phytoplankton' ka bada hissa hain jo khane ki chain ki neev hain; chlorophyll se photosynthesis karke oxygen aur khana banate hain. Kai algae khane aur dawa ke liye bhi use hote hain - jaise Spirulina aur samudri kelp (seaweed). Exam point: 'Algae = Phycology/Algology; Fungi = Mycology'.

qe: The branch of science dealing with the study of viruses is:
qh: विषाणुओं (virus) के अध्ययन की शाखा है:
e: Concept: Virology = virus ka adhyayan. Virus ek aisa jeev hai jisme khud ki cell nahi hoti - sirf ek genetic material (DNA ya RNA) aur usko dhakne wali protein ki parat (capsid) hoti hai; ise jeevit rehne aur badhne ke liye kisi doosre jeev ki cell me ghusna padta hai (obligate intracellular parasite). Isi liye antivirus dawa banana mushkil hota hai. Baaki teen: Bacteriology (bacteria), Mycology (fungi), Pathology (bimariyon ka adhyayan). Exam point: 'Virus = Virology (cell nahi hoti - sirf RNA/DNA + protein coat)'.

qe: The scientific study of cells is termed:
qh: कोशिकाओं के वैज्ञानिक अध्ययन को कहते हैं:
e: Concept: Cytology = cell ki sanrachana, uske andar ke ang (organelles), uske kaam aur uske division ka adhyayan. Ye 'cell biology' hi hai; isse pata chalta hai ki kaunsa ang kya kaam karta hai (mitochondria = energy, nucleus = control). Baaki teen alag shastr hain: Histology (tissues), Embryology (bhrun/embryo ka vikas), Morphology (bahari dhaancha/aakar). Exam point: 'Cell = Cytology; Tissue = Histology; Embryo = Embryology'.

qe: The study of tissues (groups of similar cells) is called:
qh: ऊतकों (एक जैसी कोशिकाओं के समूह) के अध्ययन को कहते हैं:
e: Concept: Histology me sharir ke tissues (ootak) padhe jate hain - jaise epithelial tissue (parat/cover), connective tissue (jodne wala - khoon, haddi), muscular (peshi) aur nervous tissue. Isi ki madad se bimariyon me tissue kaise kharab hota hai (cancer, inflammation) samjha jata hai; hospital me 'biopsy' bhi isi ka hissa hai. Baaki teen: Cytology (cells), Physiology (kaam-kaj), Taxonomy (vargikaran). Exam point: 'Tissues = Histology; Cells = Cytology'.

qe: The scientific study of embryos and their development is:
qh: भ्रूण और उनके विकास का वैज्ञानिक अध्ययन है:
e: Concept: Embryology = naya jeev garbh me kaise vikas karta hai - fertilization (sperm+egg ka milan) se lekar janm tak ke saare charan (zygote, morula, blastula, gastrula, organ formation) isi me padhe jate hain. Isi ki madad se Janm-jatiya (congenital) bimariyan aur evolution ke saare suraag milte hain - kyunki har embryo apne purvajon ke charan dohrata dikhta hai. Baaki teen: Cytology (cells), Histology (tissues), Genetics (vanshagat). Exam point: 'Embryo ka vikas = Embryology'.

qe: The study of fossils (remains of ancient organisms) is called:
qh: जीवाश्मों (प्राचीन जीवों के अवशेषों) के अध्ययन को कहते हैं:
e: Concept: Palaeontology me patthar/paraton me dabey purane jeevon ke avashesh (fossils) padhe jate hain; isse pata chalta hai ki kaun se jeev pehle the, kab gayab hue aur evolution kaise hui (jaise dinosaur ke jaise aur Archaeopteryx jaisa). Baaki teen alag vishay hain: Archaeology (manav sanskriti, purani wastu aur sabhyata ka adhyayan - insaan ki cheezein), Anthropology (manav aur uske vikas/jaatiyon ka adhyayan), Ecology (jeev aur paryavaran ka rishta). Exam point: 'Fossils = Palaeontology (keeleton/patthar me footi purani zindagi)'.

qe: Who is known as the 'Father of Botany'?
qh: 'वनस्पति विज्ञान का जनक' किसे कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Theophrastus (Aristotle ke shagird) ne pehli baar paudhon ko theen tarah se likha aur unki vargikaran (classification) ki - unki kitaab 'Historia Plantarum' paudhon par sabse purani vaigyanik rachna maani jati hai; isliye unhe 'Father of Botany' kehte hain. Baaki teen: Aristotle (Father of Biology/Zoology), Carl Linnaeus (taxonomy aur binomial system), Charles Darwin (evolution theory). Exam point: 'Botany ke janak = Theophrastus; Biology/Zoology ke janak = Aristotle'.

qe: Who is known as the 'Father of Taxonomy' (the science of classifying living organisms)?
qh: 'वर्गीकरण विज्ञान (Taxonomy) का जनक' किसे कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Carl Linnaeus (Swedish) ne jeevon ka vaigyanik vargikaran aur naam rakhne ka system (binomial nomenclature) diya, jisme har jeev ka naam do shabdon me likha jata hai (jaise Homo sapiens, Mangifera indica) - aaj bhi poori duniya yahi usool use karti hai. Taxonomy ka matlab hai jeevon ko pehchanna, naam dena aur unmo samuhon me daalna. Baaki teen alag log hain: Theophrastus (botany), Darwin (evolution), Mendel (genetics). Exam point: 'Taxonomy + binomial nomenclature ke janak = Carl Linnaeus'.

qe: Who is regarded as the 'Father of Medicine'?
qh: 'चिकित्सा का जनक' किसे माना जाता है?
e: Concept: Hippocrates (Greece, lagbhag 400 BC) ne pehli baar bimariyon ko 'devo ka koop' ya 'bhoot-pret' nahi, balki prakrutik karan (khaana, mausam, sharir ki halat) maana; unke naam se 'Hippocratic oath' aaya hai jo aaj bhi doctor apni padhai ke ant me lete hain. Baaki teen: Aristotle (Biology), Louis Pasteur (pasteurization aur germ theory), Alexander Fleming (penicillin dawa). Exam point: 'Medicine ke janak = Hippocrates (Hippocratic oath unse jura hai)'.

qe: Who discovered penicillin, the first antibiotic?
qh: सबसे पहली प्रतिजैविक दवा (antibiotic) पेनिसिलिन की खोज किसने की थी?
e: Concept: 1928 me Alexander Fleming ne dekha ki 'Penicillium notatum' naam ke fungus ke aas-paas ke bacteria mar jaate hain - iska kaaran wo padarth tha jo fungus banata tha (penicillin). Isi se duniya ki pehli antibiotic dawa bani jisne kai jaan bujhane wale bacterial rog (nimonia, wound infection) ka ilaaj sambhav kiya. Baaki teen: Louis Pasteur (pasteurization/germ theory), Robert Koch (TB ka bacteria dhoondha), Edward Jenner (smallpox vaccine). Exam point: 'Penicillin = Alexander Fleming (1928, Penicillium fungus se)'.

qe: Who developed the world's first vaccine (against smallpox)?
qh: दुनिया का पहला टीका (चेचक के विरुद्ध) किसने विकसित किया था?
e: Concept: 1796 me Edward Jenner ne dekha ki jo gaaye wali maids (doodh dohanewali) ko 'cowpox' (gaay ka phunsi rog) hota hai, unhe phir 'smallpox' (chechak - khatarnak bimari) nahi hoti; usne cowpox ka padarth ek ladke me daala aur chailenge karke dekha ki chechak theek aya - yahi vaccine ka pehla experiment tha aur 'vaccination' shabd bhi 'vacca' (Latin me gaay) se aaya. Baaki teen: Louis Pasteur (rabies vaccine bhi), Fleming (penicillin), Koch (TB). Exam point: 'Pehla vaccine (smallpox) = Edward Jenner (1796)'.

qe: Who proved that malaria is transmitted by mosquitoes?
qh: किसने सिद्ध किया कि मलेरिया मच्छरों से फैलता है?
e: Concept: Ronald Ross (India me kaam karte hue) ne 1897 me dikhaya ki malaria ek mosquito (Anopheles) ke kaatne se insaan me pahunchta hai - ye khoj itni badi thi ki unhe Nobel Prize mila. (Antedote: malaria ka parasite Plasmodium pehli baar Charles Laveran ne 1880 me dekha tha, par uska failne ka tarika - mosquito - Ronald Ross ne saabit kiya.) Baaki teen: Laveran (parasite ki khoj), Robert Koch (TB), Louis Pasteur (germ theory). Exam point: 'Malaria mosquito (Anopheles) se failta hai = Ronald Ross (Nobel 1902)'.

qe: Who discovered the bacterium that causes tuberculosis (TB)?
qh: तपेदिक (TB) पैदा करने वाले जीवाणु की खोज किसने की?
e: Concept: 1882 me Robert Koch ne TB ke rogiyon ke sputum (balgam) me se 'Mycobacterium tuberculosis' bacteria alag karke dikhaya, aur ye bhi saabit kiya ki ek khaas bacteria hi ek khaas bimari karta hai (Koch's postulates). Isi kaam ke liye unhe Nobel mila. Baaki teen: Fleming (penicillin), Pasteur (germ theory/pasteurization), Jenner (smallpox vaccine). Exam point: 'TB ka bacteria (Mycobacterium tuberculosis) = Robert Koch ne 1882 me dhoondha'.

qe: Who discovered the first virus (the tobacco mosaic virus)?
qh: पहले विषाणु (तंबाकू मोज़ेक विषाणु) की खोज किसने की?
e: Concept: 1892 me Russian scientist D.J. Ivanovsky ne dekha ki tobacco ke patton ki mosaic (dhabbedar) bimari ka keeta ek aise padarth se failta hai jo bacteria se bhi chhota hai aur bacteria-rok chhanni (filter) se guzar jata hai - ye pehli baar virus ka sanket tha. Aage 1935 me W.M. Stanley ne isi virus (TMV) ko crystal roop me alag kiya (unhe Nobel mila). Baaki teen: Pasteur, Koch alag khog. Exam point: 'Pehla virus (TMV) dhoondha = D.J. Ivanovsky; crystal banane wala = W.M. Stanley'.

qe: Who first observed bacteria using a microscope of his own making?
qh: अपने बनाए सूक्ष्मदर्शी से सबसे पहले जीवाणु (bacteria) देखने वाले वैज्ञानिक कौन थे?
e: Concept: Antonie van Leeuwenhoek (Dutch) ne apne khud ke banaye simple microscope se 1670s me sabse pehle 'animalcules' dekhe - jo asal me bacteria aur protozoa the; isi liye unhe 'Father of Microbiology' bhi kehte hain. Baaki teen: Robert Hooke ne 1665 me cork me 'cell' (khaali dibbe) dekha aur 'cell' shabd diya; Robert Koch ne TB bacteria dhoondha (par microscope alag tarah ka); Louis Pasteur ne germ theory di. Exam point: 'Bacteria pehli baar dekhne wale = Antonie van Leeuwenhoek (Father of Microbiology)'.

qe: Who wrote the book 'On the Origin of Species' and proposed the theory of natural selection?
qh: 'ऑन द ओरिजिन ऑफ स्पीशीज़' किताब लिखकर प्राकृतिक चयन (natural selection) का सिद्धांत किसने दिया?
e: Concept: Charles Darwin ne HMS Beagle ki yatra me alag-alag jagah ke jeevon (khaas kar Galapagos ke finches) ko dekh kar bataya ki jeev samay ke saath badalte hain kyunki jo apne aas-paas ke mahaul ke liye behtar dhabte hain wahi zinda rehte hain aur agali peedhi me jaate hain (natural selection = 'survival of the fittest'), aur isi tarah nayi species banti hain. Baaki teen: Mendel (genetics ke niyam), Linnaeus (taxonomy), Lamarck (purana evolution theory). Exam point: 'Natural selection / Origin of Species = Charles Darwin'.

qe: Who coined the biological term 'cell' after observing cork under a microscope in 1665?
qh: 1665 में कॉर्क को सूक्ष्मदर्शी से देखकर 'कोशिका' (cell) शब्द किसने गढ़ा?
e: Concept: Robert Hooke ne 1665 me cork (cork oak ki chhaal) ki patli katai ko apne microscope me dekha to usme shahad ke chhatte jaise chhote khaali dibbe dikhe; unhe 'cellula' (Latin me chhota kamra) naam diya - aaj wahi 'cell' hai. (Unhone sirf mrit cell ki khaali deewarein dekhi thi; jeetey cell aur unke andar ka padarth baad me Leeuwenhoek ne dekha.) Baaki teen: Leeuwenhoek (bacteria/protozoa), Robert Brown (nucleus), Rudolf Virchow (cell theory - 'Omnis cellula e cellula'). Exam point: 'Cell shabd = Robert Hooke (1665, cork me)'.

qe: Which branch of biology deals with the study of the structure and form of organisms?
qh: जीवों की बाहरी/आंतरिक संरचना और रूप के अध्ययन की शाखा कौन-सी है?
e: Concept: Morphology = kisi jeev (ya uske kisi ang) ki shakal, aakar, bahari aur andar ki sanrachana ka adhyayan - jaise patte ka aakar, phool ke hisse, haddi ki banti. Iske andar hi 'anatomy' (angon ki andar ki banawat) aur 'histology' (tissues) aa jate hain. Baaki teen alag shastr hain: Physiology (ang kaise kaam karte hain), Ecology (jeev aur paryavaran ka rishta), Genetics (vanshagat/DNA). Exam point: 'Dhaancha/shakal = Morphology; kaam-kaj = Physiology'.
